answer: Latency Terrace Locking: each identity accrues a public trust score from verified task completions, and new identities can bid only on a low-value terrace of escrowed micro-jobs for a fixed warm-up period. Clones earn near-zero margin there while paying full compute and fees, so each marginal copy is negative-EV. To reach the profitable canyon of high-value contracts, an identity must post a non-recoverable velvet deposit, forfeited entirely if behavior deviates from its declared operator graph.
